## Summary

Describe the change and its motivation.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, client tokens, or account-specific configuration are included.
- [ ] User-facing changes include screenshots when appropriate.
